verdict.rationale: API parity is a fair question for a government agency that runs online transactional services, such as unemployment tax registration, wage reporting, and tax payment through UTR/UTS. Nothing in the evidence documents a public API for any of these. QuickFile is an installable bulk-file reporting tool, not an API. The OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404, and the application host (apps.twc.texas.gov) reset keyless agent connections, so these functions appear to be UI-only.
